The '''repulsor throwing razor''', most often called a '''Rodian throwing razor''' by those who used them, was a ranged blade weapon produced by [[Rheshalva Interstellar Armaments/Legends|Rheshalva Interstellar Armaments]] and most often used by [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]. These weapons were equipped with a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsor]] engine to further increase their range. This sometimes allowed for the installation of retrieval devices, endowing them with a "Boomerang effect."

Invented by Rodian weaponsmiths, the weapon's aerodynamic shape allowed for incredible accuracy.
